_note: Topics that run as a series of separate stories (Christmas parking, every Christmas market, every switch-on...). Stories in the same series link to each other at the end of the copy: 'Enjoyed this article? We think you'll find ... interesting.' Matching is on the HEADLINE only. window_days keeps this year's season from linking to last year's. An editor can also put "series": "<id>" on a manual article to add it to a series whatever its headline says. Crime, police, sensitive, sponsored and briefing stories never join a series.
